description.value:
Duration constant

A Passing you perform while not in an encounter does not trigger reactions, and its manipulate and concentrate traits do not draw attention that would otherwise interrupt it. This does not apply during an encounter, even a quiet one — if initiative has been rolled, the rite is not unhurried.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ashcantor's entire signature resource system (Passage, a Passing, Walking Through, Embers, Ash-Light) has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- the class card itself (classes.ashcantor.json) ships system.rules: [], and no abilities/ or class-features/ card exists to hold a Passage/Ember mechanic either. Checked pf2e's own generic SpecialResource rule element (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts:24-247) as a possible fit: every real user (Alchemist's Versatile Vials, Gunslinger's Munitions Machinist, Fumbus's iconic feats) is a daily-refilling consumable counter, never a one-way permanent-increase track like Passage -- no real class resource matches Passage's shape, so there is no base mechanic here to extend or modify. Specifically, this suppresses trait-driven reaction-triggering for "a Passing," but a Passing isn't an item with a traits array to alter (pf2e's ItemAlteration rule element can add/remove traits from a real owned item, but there is no Passing item to target).
